note: Purely conceptual/code lesson, as called out directly in this course's build brief (reorg handling named explicitly as a conceptual topic with no UI to show). A reorg is, by definition, something that is never visible in a block explorer's normal UI after the fact -- the whole point is that the discarded blocks disappear from view, so there is no real screenshot that honestly represents 'a reorg happening.' Consistent with SCREENSHOTS.md's architecture-theory exception, this stays on code slides. ethers v6 tx.wait(confirmations) and viem's waitForTransactionReceipt(confirmations)/watchBlocks syntax verified via WebFetch against their current official docs; reorg/finality framing cross-checked against ethereum.org's own consensus mechanism documentation.
